 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. For the second straight week, Detroit Lions wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown 's status for a game is up in the air.
 Ahead of the Week 10 game in Munich, Germany, St. Brown is listed as questionable to play with a rib injury.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As was the case last week, the Lions wide receiver turned in three limited practices in the week leading up to the game before getting the designation.
 MORE: Bold predictions in Fantasy Football Week 10 
 Here's what we know about St. Brown's chances of suiting up on Sunday against the New England Patriots.
 Is Amon-Ra St. Brown playing today?
 Detroit Lions wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown (14) makes a catch during the second quarter against the Minnesota Vikings at Ford Field. Credit: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)
 UPDATE: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport is confirming that St. Brown is indeed going to play, as expected.
 "Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is listed as questionable and expected to play in Detroit's game in Germany," Rapoport wrote.
 END OF UPDATE 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While nobody has confirmed St. Brown's status, history tells us he is going to play against the Patriots on Sunday.
 St. Brown has garnered the reputation as one of the toughest players in the NFL during his career because he has played through some injuries most players succumb to.
 In fact, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported that whenever he reaches out to his source with the Lions to ask if St. Brown is going to play with an injury, he nearly gets laughed at.
 MORE: Fantasy Football wide receiver rankings for Week 10 
 "He's officially listed as questionable, but I would be surprised if he didn't play," Fowler stated. "He always plays. I was talking to people in Detroit. anytime I check on St. Brown they almost laugh it off like, yeah, he's going to play. He once played on a high-ankle sprain on a Thursday night and balled out, so, that's the expectation."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement St. Brown has even more motivation to play this week because the game is in Germany, where his family has roots with his mother being born and raised in Leverkusen, Germany.
 There is no way St. Brown is sitting out on Sunday.
 Amon-Ra St. Brown fantasy advice
 Detroit Lions wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown (14) warms up before the game against the Buffalo Bills at New Highmark Stadium. Credit: Gregory Fisher-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)
 You know the drill here: St. Brown is never on the bench, regardless of matchup.
 But get excited for the potential he posts absurd production on Sunday.
 Not only are the Patriots giving up the most fantasy points per game to wide receivers this season, according to CBS Sports , but St. Brown is going to be extra motivated to produce a memorable showing because the game is in Germany.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement St. Brown hasn't scored a touchdown since Week 3, which is shocking, but we think the Lions will make it a point to get him one in Munich.
